copy.copyFailed: The text is selected. Copy it with your keyboard or menu.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.heading: This page does not exist.
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the address may have a typo.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.heading: Something broke on our end.
crash.body: This page failed to load. Try again, and if it keeps happening, <link>let us know</link> so we can fix it.

language.label: Language: {language}
language.failed: The language did not change. Try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.text: Sign in to update the site.

tooMany.title: Too many attempts
tooMany.later: Try again in a few minutes.

unreachable.title: Could not reach the server
unreachable.detail: Check the connection and try again.

summary.noReleases: No releases published yet. Publish one on GitHub to install it here.
summary.noReleasesFrom: No releases published yet. Publish one from <link>{label}</link> or on GitHub to install it here.
summary.badTag: The latest release is tagged {tag}, not vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, so it cannot be installed.
summary.upToDate: The site runs the latest release.
summary.older: The release marked latest, {tag}, is older than the installed {installed}, so there is nothing to install.
summary.withdrawn: {tag} was taken back out after it kept stopping, so it is not offered again. Publish the fix as a newer release.
summary.updateByHand: {tag} is ready to install in place of the folder uploaded by hand.

off.title: Updates are off
off.fix: Put {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} right in .env and restart the server. Every other admin page works as usual.

panel.heading: Update the site
panel.explain: Builds the release beside the live site and switches only once it starts. If anything fails, the site stays as it is.
panel.viewOnly: Your account can see updates but not install them.

notServed.title: Updates are off here
notServed.body: The site was not started with npm run serve, so it cannot update itself. Set the server's startup command to npm run serve and restart it.

panel.waiting: Waiting for the updater to pick up the request.
panel.restarting: The site is restarting. Waiting for it to answer.

signedOut.title: Signed out
signedOut.watching: Your session ran out. Sign in again to see how the update went.
signedOut.text: Your session ran out. Sign in again.

install.label: Install
install.detail: npm ci, in a new folder

build.label: Build
build.detail: npm run build, keeping old assets

prune.label: Clean up
prune.detail: Tests, dev configs and dev packages removed

migrate.label: Database
migrate.detail: A backup first, then the database changes

switch.label: Switch
switch.detail: Restart on the new build, or roll back

updaterChanged.title: The updater itself changed
updaterChanged.body: This release changes the updater, which keeps running from the uploaded folder. Press the button to copy the new one over from .updater/releases/{tag}/scripts/, then restart the server from the panel.
updaterChanged.copiedBody: Now restart the server from the panel to finish. This message goes away after the restart.
updaterChanged.sessionRanOut: Your session ran out. Sign in again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is nothing at this address.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This page hit an error. Try again, and if it keeps happening, the server console has the details.

errors.mayNotUpdate: This account may not install updates.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.busy: Busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.tooManyCopies: That is a lot of copies in an hour. Try again later.
errors.notFromHere: This request did not come from this site.
errors.tooLarge: That is more than this request takes.
errors.unknownLanguage: That is not one of the admin's languages.
errors.languageNotSaved: The language could not be saved to the account.
errors.languageKept: This account keeps its own language, and the admin cannot change it here.

problems.tokenMissing: GITHUB_TOKEN is not set. The Updates page reads the releases with it: a fine-grained token with Contents read-only on the repository, or read and write where the admin also saves to it.
problems.repoForm: GITHUB_REPO is not in the form owner/name.
problems.apiHttps: GITHUB_API_URL is not an https address.
problems.apiPlain: GITHUB_API_URL must be a plain address, with nothing after the host but a path.
problems.refused: GitHub refused the token (401). Check GITHUB_TOKEN in .env and that it has not expired.
problems.rateLimit: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again in a few minutes.
problems.forbidden: The token may not read {repo} (403). It needs Contents: Read-only on that repository, or Read and write for an admin that saves to it.
problems.missingRepo: GitHub could not find {repo} (404). Check GITHUB_REPO, and that the token can read the repository.
problems.timeout: GitHub did not answer within {seconds} seconds.
problems.notServe: Updates only work when the site is started with npm run serve.
problems.waiting: An update is already waiting to start.
problems.copyingAlready: The updater is being copied already. Try again in a moment.
problems.copyNotServe: This only works when the site is started with npm run serve.
problems.copyBusy: An update is running. Try again when it is done.
problems.copyNoRelease: No release is installed, so there is no new updater to copy.
problems.copyNoBuild: The build of {tag} is not there any more, so there is no updater to copy from it.
